agreements: v2 is only a fixed-prompt, one-way, pre-context external-text DEV assay on the registered roots; it is not lifetime learning, a recurrent organism, parameter learning, LoRA, compression, persistence, a learned controller, or paper evidence.

The current G04 receipt can identify only a nonsemantic raw-A-conditioned, parent-bound, provenance-complete, byte-distinct REPLACE selection; it cannot identify semantic correction, composition, appropriate terminal choice, or h-mediated later action.

The selected-h action contrast, if valid, is an effect of the complete assigned corpus-reader-Think-actor bundle on registered behavior, not a Dream-authoring, retrieval-mechanism, or comparator-superiority attribution.
Stage 2 is conditional on the Stage-1 conjunction, and q is a descriptive alarm; neither is replication, a population estimate, specificity proof, or independent-call sample size.
No implementation, fixture realization, model call, GPU run, scientific claim change, or ratification is authorized by this consensus.

disagreements.issue: The closed input contract omits the live workspace bytes and accumulated read-receipt/value state needed by recurrent Dream and Think, particularly after both G04 reads.

positions.position: Current-session workspace visibility is intended, but it must not be silently supplied through a hidden transcript, KV cache, or undeclared orchestrator state.
Current bytes do not render that state through a declared typed, token-accounted path, so faithful recurrent execution is impossible without materially changing the contract.

resolution.rationale: The critic is correct on the exact reviewed bytes. Declaring own-session visibility does not identify the bytes in the next invocation or exclude hidden history.
resolution.selected_position: Require a rehashed exact input-envelope design before ratification.
resolution.required_change: Specify one typed, rendered next-invocation envelope containing every live workspace node/value and every authorized accumulated read result/receipt reference needed by the reducer, including both G04 reads; account its exact tokens and reset it per invocation. Reject hidden transcript, KV, history, filesystem, cache, and unledgered state. Amend the rehashed versions of existing T05/T06/T10/T14/T18 with a multi-step rendered-envelope positive and hidden-state negative; no new test ID is available in this proposal registry.

disagreements.issue: The four-USE D4 loop requires public actor results to update the same Think session, but the graph routes actor output only to a terminal node.

positions.position: The registry says Think consumes public next state and validity, so an authorized feedback route may have been intended.
The graph has no such edge or renderer, and implementation cannot choose one without changing the causal and visibility contract.

resolution.rationale: An intended consumer list cannot repair a missing graph edge. Without it the claimed recurrent path is incomplete; inventing it creates undeclared cognition input.
resolution.selected_position: Rework the graph and all dependent contracts before ratification.
resolution.required_change: Add one explicit PUBLIC_ACTOR public-next-state/action-validity return edge to TARGET_THINK or a named typed renderer, with four-step D4 trace semantics that update action ordinal, current tray/state, and legal menu. Prove the edge excludes target truth, B, score, comparator, evaluation, treatment, reader/memory data, and private transition bytes. Amend rehashed T03/T05/T06/T08/T14/T18 accordingly; preserve USE-only actor IPC and Think-local LOCK.

disagreements.issue: target_menu_packet and ONE_SHOT_PLAN require a model-visible target_id, while the registry and visibility matrix forbid target identity at TARGET_THINK.

positions.position: The target-time firewall requires fixed treatment-invariant public packets and forbids target identity/truth leakage.
The operative packet/output requirement contradicts that firewall and must be reconciled in exact bytes.

resolution.rationale: The reviewed proposal contains incompatible model-visibility instructions; an implementation choice would be a material visibility decision.
resolution.selected_position: Remove model-visible target_id unless a separately specified opaque label can be proven answer-neutral.
resolution.required_change: Rehash contracts so target_id is absent from every Think input/output byte, including target_menu_packet and ONE_SHOT_PLAN; alternatively explicitly authorize only a fixed opaque label and prove it is treatment-invariant and answer-neutral at every Think boundary. Add this closure to rehashed T02/T03/T05/T06/T08/T14; do not expose target truth or goal-twin identity.

disagreements.issue: MODEL_READ_RESULT echoes the model-authored query, leaving a query-to-agenda/scratchpad channel that can mimic retrieved-memory support.

positions.position: The reader/Think/actor split prevents direct corpus-to-actor access but does not by itself identify the useful channel within Think.
Query echo can carry agenda state across calls and is not separated from NOTE/AST value by a causal fixture.

resolution.rationale: The exact current mutation suite does not independently vary query/status and immutable memory value, so it cannot distinguish retrieval from model-authored carried state.
resolution.selected_position: Treat query text as model state, never retrieved evidence, and require a channel-separation fixture.
resolution.required_change: Specify whether the query is omitted from the returned result or is an explicitly tainted model-state echo. Amend rehashed T05/T06/T08/T11/T18/T19 to hold NOTE/AST value and receipt fixed while removing/mutating echoed query, then hold query/status fixed while mutating memory value; report citation/action changes and forbid query text from counting as retrieved evidence.

disagreements.issue: The compose/self-revision framing is broader than G04's observable nonsemantic REPLACE receipt.

positions.position: G04 proves branch-responsive selected-object replacement, not composition, semantic correction, or appropriate RETAIN/REPLACE/ABSTAIN choice.
Opaque branch-distinct bytes have no established semantic relation to A and cannot support content-revision language.
Title and shorthand must be expressly nonclaim labels or revised before release.

resolution.rationale: The proposed body already contains the correct narrow descriptor; its broader labels must not be used as earned scientific mechanism wording.
resolution.selected_position: Only nonsemantic raw-A-conditioned selected-object REPLACE receipt plus separately measured assigned-corpus bundle behavior is reportable.
resolution.required_change: In the repaired rehash, either rename title/claim-facing shorthand or mark each compose/self-revision string as a project label with no evidentiary force; lint reports against semantic correction, content rewrite, composition, contradiction handling, appropriate terminal selection, and h-mediated-action wording. A future semantic or mediation claim requires a new deliberated proposal, not a v2 implementation change.

disagreements.issue: The assay does not identify h-mediated action, Think dependency-path construction, Dream-versus-reader/prior attribution, comparator superiority, recurrence necessity, efficiency, scaling, or organism/lifetime learning.

positions.position: Credit is limited to separate raw-A-to-selection and assigned-corpus-reader-Think-actor behavioral clauses; the path and mediation are unmeasured.
The fixed one-way text circuit and incomplete controls cannot establish a full flywheel, learning system, external-memory superiority, or recurrence/efficiency result.
These are nonblocking only if every report retains the whole-bundle, noncomparative, non-mediation boundary.

resolution.rationale: The proposed narrow DEV boundary supports no stronger conclusion, and no stronger conclusion is needed to state the bounded plumbing assay.
resolution.selected_position: Preserve all listed limitations as mandatory report and human-ratification boundaries.
resolution.required_change: Keep omitted comparator cells NOT_RUN/non-comparative; describe terminal behavior only for the complete assigned bundle; forbid claims of multi-hop path construction, Dream-specific causal value, mediation, recurrence/efficiency, lifetime, online learning, persistence, LoRA, compression, learned control, generalization, or paper efficacy. New mediation/path/comparator/lifetime evidence requires new material deliberation.

disagreements.issue: Stage 2 is success-selected and q is low-coverage, so nested calls and paired endpoints cannot be read as replication, population effect size, or specificity proof.

positions.position: Stage 2 is a conditional canary and q is a descriptive alarm only.
The four selected-h endpoints are a circuit-survival criterion, not an estimand, and a quiet q cannot rule out shortcuts.

resolution.rationale: The exact analysis contract already provides the only defensible interpretation when its literal conditionality and no-inference language are preserved.
resolution.selected_position: Use literal failure-inclusive Stage-1/Stage-2 and q reporting with no statistical/generalization gloss.
resolution.required_change: Preserve separate conditional reports, three-root independence accounting, and the prohibition on p-values, intervals, prevalence, replication, confirmation, population, and specificity claims. Any such claim requires independently powered untouched roots/lives and a new proposal.

disagreements.issue: The 3,414-call roster has exact arithmetic but no frozen forecast estimator, workload match, confidence/safety rule, or pass/fail inequality for the 18-device-hour and 24-wall-hour stops.

positions.position: Exact token and call ceilings are capacity constraints, not evidence that the workload will fit the named runtime.
A hash-bound forecast requirement without method or numerical margin cannot deterministically pass T16/T17; timeout worst case is incompatible.

resolution.rationale: No current-byte source selects a valid estimator or uncertainty allowance. A later implementation cannot fill that scientific resource choice silently.
resolution.selected_position: Require a deterministic forecast rule in a repaired, rehashed proposal.
resolution.required_change: Freeze throughput source, estimator, workload/context/device adjustment, numerical safety margin, confidence rule, and strict inequalities for 18 device-hours and 24 wall-hours. The fixture must return NOT_RUN for unsupported workload matching, unverifiable forecast, or failure; it must not alter hardware, runtime, tokens, cells, or roster. Amend rehashed T16 and T17 (and dependent T14/T15) with this exact zero-science fixture.

disagreements.issue: The ancestry suite tests acyclicity but lacks a valid shared-ancestry diamond, permitting a global-visited false-cycle implementation defect.

positions.position: Multi-source connection shapes should be legal when provenance is an acyclic DAG.
Existing chain and true-cycle negatives do not prove that shared ancestry is accepted without duplicate evidence inflation.

resolution.rationale: The positive acceptance case is absent and cannot be inferred from generic acyclicity requirements.
resolution.selected_position: Add a concrete positive/negative graph fixture before ratification.
resolution.required_change: Amend the rehashed existing T06/T07/T10/T17 fixture obligations to accept a path-local-cycle-detected valid diamond with a shared parent and later CONNECT citing both children, while rejecting self-edge, back-edge, and true-cycle cases and preventing synthetic re-expression from being counted as independent evidence.

disagreements.issue: Older bound advisories name earlier proposal hashes and therefore constrain/recount history but do not certify the exact current change bytes.

positions.position: Earlier audits are useful context but cannot automatically carry certification forward.
Current-byte review and the future executable snapshot must be independently bound to their exact hashes.

resolution.rationale: This consensus binds the current 1d4e9ca8 proposal and preserves older material only as constraints/history.
resolution.selected_position: Require a fresh chain after every proposal repair.
resolution.required_change: Do not claim an older advisory certifies repaired bytes. Rehash the repaired proposal and all changed contracts, obtain new independent interpretations/critique/consensus and human ratification, then bind the post-ratification executable snapshot to that ratified chain before T17/pre-GPU review.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Exact current bytes lack a declared model-visible recurrent-state rendering path.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Complete ADJ-D01 before ratification; current bytes must not be implemented with hidden state.

G04 is a mechanical replacement receipt, not semantic composition or revision.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Apply ADJ-D05 wording and claim lint in the repaired chain.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The proposal correctly separates the two causal clauses and cannot link them by mediation.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Keep mediation wording forbidden; a mediation test is a future material proposal.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Endpoint behavior cannot establish cited path construction or isolate the bundled components.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Retain whole-bundle/noncomparative reporting; future mechanism claims require new direct interventions and comparator design.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The fixed one-way pre-context circuit is deliberately not a full learning organism.
The qualified one-shot rows do not identify recurrence necessity, efficiency, or scale.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Keep recurrence/efficiency claims retired pending a separately deliberated matched design.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The stated literal conditional/descriptive boundary is the only valid interpretation.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Preserve separate reports and no-inference language.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Exact budget totals do not define a reproducible fit forecast.

Historical advisories are constraints, not certification of current or repaired bytes.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Use a fresh hash-bound chain after repair.

G04 does not identify the broader framing.
Final endpoints do not score a dependency path.
This is an incomplete organ assay, not a full organism test.

The one-shot diagnostics are not recurrence/efficiency controls.

The rehashed T02 must close target-id/opaque-label visibility and preserve treatment-free identifiers.
The rehashed T03 must trace four actor-feedback steps and target-id absence/neutrality.
Retain q matching and descriptive-only alarm semantics.
The rehashed T05 must render recurrent state, actor feedback, target privacy, and query taint/channel separation.
The rehashed T06 must type the full recurrent envelope, feedback edge, target privacy, query taint, and diamond behavior.
The rehashed T07 must include the valid shared-ancestry diamond without broadening the one-shot claim.
The rehashed T08 must test actor-feedback exclusions, target identity, and independent query-versus-memory mutations.
Retain opaque/AST separation and target-blind sham timing.
The rehashed T10 must show full visible G04 recurrence and valid provenance diamond behavior while preserving the nonsemantic boundary.
The rehashed T11 must distinguish returned immutable value from query/status echo and forbid the latter as evidence.
Retain sealed roster exclusions and non-comparative lane boundary.
The rehashed T14 must reject hidden recurrent state/feedback channels and bind the repaired deterministic forecast dependencies.
The rehashed T15 must make missing deterministic forecast evidence whole-roster NOT_RUN without roster mutation.

The rehashed T19 must retain query-channel separation and claim-boundary enforcement in conditional Stage 2.

questions: Will the proposal be repaired and rehashed before ratification to render the full recurrent workspace and authorized read receipts through one typed, token-accounted input path with no hidden transcript/KV/history?

What exact public-only actor feedback edge and renderer returns next state/action validity to Think between USE operations while excluding B, truth, score, evaluation, treatment, memory, and private transitions?
Will target_id be removed from all model-visible target/one-shot bytes, or will a newly authorized opaque label be proven treatment-invariant and answer-neutral?
Will query echo be treated as model-authored state rather than retrieved evidence and be causally separated from NOTE/AST value?
Will the repaired proposal freeze a deterministic workload-matched forecast, numerical safety margin, and strict 18-device-hour/24-wall-hour NOT_RUN rule?

Does the decision owner accept the narrow earned descriptor and the permanent v2 limits on semantic revision, composition, mediation, mechanism, comparators, recurrence/efficiency, lifetime learning, and generalization?
After a new full hash-bound deliberation chain, will human ratification authorize only scoped implementation and Stage 0, preserving fresh T17 review and separate exact pre-GPU approval?
